task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: Navigate CAR to FRONT_CRATE, pick it up to remove obstacle, then navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, pick it up, navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE, and place the bottle there.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of CAR that needs to be removed
After removing FRONT_CRATE, CAR can navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE
MEDICINE_BOTTLE is within interaction distance after navigation
MEDICAL_TABLE is within interaction distance after navigation for placing
CAR can hold only one object at a time, so FRONT_CRATE must be placed somewhere before picking MEDICINE_BOTTLE
